title: Cartwise+ Membership Settled Share of a Past-Due Period
content:
When a Cartwise+ Membership member settles a past-due period, the share of the period fee that is settled depends on whether the plan's order benefits stop while past due and on how long the membership has been past due.

**Rule.**

(a) On a plan whose order benefits stop while past due, when the membership has been past due for at least the plan's retry interval in calendar days (counted from the past-due date up to the day before today), only the days of the period still ahead are settled: the period fee multiplied by the calendar days from today up to the day before the renewal date, divided by the days in the period.

(b) On a plan whose order benefits stop while past due, when the membership has been past due for fewer days than that, the whole weeks of benefits withheld are taken off: the period fee multiplied by the days in the period less the whole weeks past due multiplied by 7, divided by the days in the period.

(c) On a plan whose order benefits keep applying while past due, the whole period fee is settled.

## Figures per plan

| Plan | Order benefits while past due | Retry interval (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|
| Cartwise+ Assist Monthly | stop | 3 |
| Cartwise+ Student Monthly | stop | 3 |
| Cartwise+ Monthly | stop | 3 |
| Cartwise+ Annual | keep applying | 4 |
| Cartwise+ Family Annual | keep applying | 4 |
| Cartwise+ Premier Annual | keep applying | 4 |

## Terms

- **Days past due**: the calendar days from the past-due date on the membership record up to the day before today — the same as today less the past-due date.
- **Whole weeks past due**: the days past due divided by 7, any part week dropped.
- **Days in the period**: the calendar days from the period's first day up to the day before its renewal date.

## Hypothetical cases (period 12 April to 12 May, 30 days, fee 9.99, benefits stop, retry interval 3)

| Past due since | Today | Days past due | Share settled |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12 April | 20 April | 8 | (a): 20 April up to 11 May is 22 days; 22 over 30 |
| 12 April | 15 April | 3 | (a): 27 days ahead; 27 over 30 |
| 12 April | 14 April | 2 | (b): 0 whole weeks; 30 less 0, over 30, the whole fee |

On a plan whose benefits keep applying while past due, the whole fee is settled whatever the days past due.
